brief:
Israeli forces bombed a water desalination station in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of northern Gaza today, according to local sources cited by Shehab Wire. The strike resulted in casualties, though specific figures were not immediately available from initial reports.

The attack targeted infrastructure serving a civilian population facing acute water shortages. The desalination plant in Sheikh Radwan, a densely populated residential area north of Gaza City, plays a vital role in supplying fresh water to thousands of residents. The bombing marks another strike on essential utilities during the ongoing conflict.
